map.ariaLabel: Map of Australia coloured by local area
map.hint: Select an area on the map, or search for one, to see its details.
map.areaCaveat: These are area-level figures. They describe areas, not individual women or communities.
map.diversityLine: Across areas, screening rates don’t rise or fall steadily with the share of women born overseas, who speak another language at home, or who don't speak English well, and they vary widely within every group.
map.note: Participation uses the most recent reporting window available. Population figures are from the 2021 Census. Areas where participation data is suppressed or unreliable are shown in yellow.
